summary: First MVP test of Save & Cook app. All 7 backend API tests passed. Frontend UI renders correctly with proper French language, navigation, planner grid, and URL validation working.

integration_issues.issue: Clicking 'Recettes' nav link routes to '/' (homepage) instead of a dedicated /recipes route. The recipe list appears to be on the homepage, which may confuse users.

issues: Validation error shows browser native 'Please enter a URL.' tooltip instead of a custom French error message - should show 'URL YouTube invalide' in French

action_items: Consider adding a dedicated /recipes route or confirm that homepage is the intended recipe list page
Replace browser native URL validation with custom French error message ('URL YouTube invalide')
critical_code_review_comments: backend/.env has malformed line: CORS_ORIGINS="*"EMERGENT_LLM_KEY=sk-... - these two env vars are on the same line without newline, which could cause EMERGENT_LLM_KEY to not be loaded properly
URL validation relies on browser's built-in type='url' validation rather than app-level validation - 'not-a-url' shows browser tooltip not a custom French error

success_rate.frontend: 90% - all pages load, minor UX issues

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend all green. Frontend: homepage=IngestPage, /planner=PlannerPage. Recettes nav goes to '/'. Planner shows 7-day grid (LUN-DIM) with 3 meal rows. Prev/next week arrow buttons work. No auth required. EMERGENT_LLM_KEY may have parsing issue in .env (on same line as CORS_ORIGINS).
